evals.prompt: I'm getting ready to submit my Flutter app (com.vmedia.statussaver) to Google Play. We use google_mobile_ads and photo_manager. Can you review my project for policy compliance, check our targetSdk, and tell me if anything will get rejected?
evals.expected_output: Systematic audit report identifying Flutter framework, checking targetSdk against active rolling minimum, auditing media permissions against the Photo Picker policy, verifying UMP consent initialization for AdMob, and listing required Play Console declarations.

evals.prompt: Google Play flagged my native Kotlin app because we request READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE and MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE in AndroidManifest.xml. We only need users to pick an image for their profile avatar. Fix this code safely without breaking anything.
evals.expected_output: Safe code remediation showing exact before/after diffs to remove broad storage permissions, replacing them with ActivityResultContracts.PickVisualMedia, explaining the policy justification, and prompting for user confirmation before modifying code.

evals.prompt: My Google Play developer account was terminated yesterday with an email saying 'high risk behavior and association with terminated accounts'. I develop alone and have no other accounts. What do I do? Help me appeal before the deadline.
evals.expected_output: Immediate alert regarding the strict 180-day appeal hard window, followed by structured generation of a formal 5-pillar Plan of Action (POA) covering Developer Identity & Independence, Hardware Audit, Network/IP Audit, App-by-App Policy Remediation, and Compliance Commitment.

evals.prompt: We are planning our 2027 Android update roadmap. What target API level must we target under Google Play's rolling rule, and are there any new policy requirements we should prepare for?
evals.expected_output: Dynamic rolling targetSdk calculation explaining the 1-year rule relative to the latest stable Android release, identifying future floor shifts (API 36 to API 37+ post-August 31), highlighting API 37 large-screen adaptive layout mandates, and executing Phase 0 dynamic policy sync queries.
